description: This PHP source file defines an abstract base Data Access Object (DAO) class, 'BaseDao', for the OrangeHRM HRM system. It provides common database query functionalities such as counting records, setting sorting, pagination, and combined sorting and pagination based on filter parameters. The class utilizes Doctrine ORM and includes traits for EntityManager helper methods.

classes.name: BaseDao
classes.description: An abstract class providing common database querying functionalities like counting, sorting, and pagination for DAO implementations within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the number of records matching the current QueryBuilder criteria.

methods.name: setSortingParams
methods.description: Applies sorting to the QueryBuilder based on filtering parameters.

methods.name: setPaginationParams
methods.description: Applies pagination limits to the QueryBuilder based on filtering parameters.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Combines sorting and pagination settings on the QueryBuilder.
